"""Limited C1 installed-module probe; dependencies use the existing interpreter.

Not a full application, dependency-isolated or OS-containment certification.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def run(target: Path, checkout: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if (
        not checkout.is_absolute()
        or target.is_relative_to(checkout)
        or Path.cwd().is_relative_to(checkout)
    ):
        raise ValueError("probe must run outside checkout")
    if not target.is_absolute() or not (target / "maskgw/runtime/domain.py").is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing installed C1")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(target))
    domain = importlib.import_module("maskgw.runtime.domain")
    budget = importlib.import_module("maskgw.runtime.budget")
    job = importlib.import_module("maskgw.runtime.worker_job")
    db = importlib.import_module("maskgw.db.postgres")
    engine = importlib.import_module("maskgw.masking.engine")
    policy = importlib.import_module("maskgw.masking.rules")
    framing = importlib.import_module("maskgw.pgwire.result_frame")
    adapter = db.PostgresAdapter("", engine.MaskingEngine(policy.MaskingPolicy(exceptions=(), rules=())))
    identity = framing.ResultIdentity(session_id=b"s"*16, datasource_id=b"d"*16, generation=1, record_revision=1, job_id=1)
    outcome = job.run_job(adapter, "SELECT 1", identity=identity, limits=framing.ResultLimits(max_rows=1000), deadline=framing.ResultDeadline(expires_at=10, clock=lambda: 1))
    if outcome.frame is not None or outcome.failure is not job.JobFailure.CONNECTION or outcome.can_continue:
        raise ValueError("closed adapter job did not fail safely")
    origins = {}
    matched = 0
    for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
        if name == "maskgw" or name.startswith("maskgw."):
            source = getattr(module, "__file__", None)
            if type(source) is not str or not Path(source).resolve().is_relative_to(target):
                raise ValueError("wrong module origin")
            installed = Path(source).resolve()
            reviewed = checkout / "src" / installed.relative_to(target)
            if installed.read_bytes() != reviewed.read_bytes():
                raise ValueError("installed module differs from reviewed source")
            matched += 1
    for name, module in (("domain", domain), ("budget", budget)):
        filename = module.__file__
        if type(filename) is not str:
            raise ValueError("missing module origin")
        origins[name] = hashlib.sha256(Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    q = domain.Quantity.VIRTUAL_ADDRESS_SPACE
    costs = tuple(
        domain.Cost(index, owner, domain.CostLocation.IN_DOMAIN, q, size, count)
        for index, owner, size, count in (
            (1, domain.CostOwner.BASE, 200, 1),
            (2, domain.CostOwner.HEADROOM, 100, 1),
            (3, domain.CostOwner.WORKER, 256, 2),
            (4, domain.CostOwner.PARENT, 256, 2),
            (5, domain.CostOwner.CANDIDATE, 50, 1),
            (6, domain.CostOwner.GENERATION, 50, 2),
            (7, domain.CostOwner.AUXILIARY, 64, 1),
        )
    )
    plan = domain.CostPlan(q, costs, 1, 2, 1, 1, 0, 1, None, 80, 40)
    limits = budget.BudgetLimits(10000, 200, 100, 8, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1)
    results = {}
    for profile in (domain.LINUX_HELD_AS128, domain.WINDOWS_JOB_PRIVATE32):
        result = domain.reconcile(profile, plan, limits)
        if result.ready or domain.DomainReason.AGGREGATE_UNPROVEN not in result.reasons:
            raise ValueError("unsafe profile verdict")
        results[profile.name] = tuple(reason.value for reason in result.reasons)
    return {
        "python": sys.version.split()[0],
        "known_profiles_not_ready": results,
        "module_hashes": origins,
        "source_match": True,
        "matched_module_count": matched,
        "maskgw_outside_checkout": True,
        "dependencies": "existing interpreter, not isolated",
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(run(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()), sort_keys=True))

from maskgw.db.execution_error import classify_typed_error, ExecutionFailure, TypedExecutionTimeout
from maskgw.errors import QueryTimeout
from psycopg import errors
f = classify_typed_error(errors.OutOfMemory())
assert f.category is ExecutionFailure.RESOURCE and not f.continuation_candidate
f = classify_typed_error(errors.QueryCanceled())
assert isinstance(f, (TypedExecutionTimeout, QueryTimeout)) and f.continuation_candidate
f = classify_typed_error(errors.DivisionByZero())
assert f.category is ExecutionFailure.QUERY and f.continuation_candidate

    packaged = {name: archive.read(name) for name in archive.namelist()
                if name.startswith("maskgw/") and name.endswith(".py")}
    assert packaged == reviewed
    wheel_members = len(items)
extract = root / "extracted"
extract.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(sdist, "r:gz") as archive:
    items = archive.getmembers()
    names_ok([item.name for item in items])
    assert all(item.isdir() or item.isfile() for item in items)
    assert sum(item.size for item in items) <= 16 * 1024 * 1024
    assert all(item.name.split("/")[0] == "maskgw-0.1.0" for item in items)
    archive.extractall(extract, members=items)
    sdist_members = len(items)
probe = root / "domain_package_probe.py"
shutil.copyfile(checkout / "tests/domain_package_probe.py", probe)
probe.write_text(probe.read_text("utf8").replace("    origins = {}", '    job = importlib.import_module("maskgw.runtime.worker_job")\n    db = importlib.import_module("maskgw.db.postgres")\n    engine = importlib.import_module("maskgw.masking.engine")\n    policy = importlib.import_module("maskgw.masking.rules")\n    framing = importlib.import_module("maskgw.pgwire.result_frame")\n    adapter = db.PostgresAdapter("", engine.MaskingEngine(policy.MaskingPolicy(exceptions=(), rules=())))\n    identity = framing.ResultIdentity(session_id=b"s"*16, datasource_id=b"d"*16, generation=1, record_revision=1, job_id=1)\n    outcome = job.run_job(adapter, "SELECT 1", identity=identity, limits=framing.ResultLimits(max_rows=1000), deadline=framing.ResultDeadline(expires_at=10, clock=lambda: 1))\n    if outcome.frame is not None or outcome.failure is not job.JobFailure.CONNECTION or outcome.can_continue:\n        raise ValueError("closed adapter job did not fail safely")\n    origins = {}'), encoding="utf8")
